texts.preamble: Chandrakanth Siddarth Kamble vs The State Of Telangana on 22 November, 2023 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy Writ Petition No.32202 Of 2023 Order:
texts.arguments: The case of the petitioner is that he is engaged in the business of trading of garments in the State of Maharashtra for the past 10 years. It is further case of the petitioner that on 24.01.2023 a proclamation notice under Section 82 of Cr.P.C. read with Section 7 of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Boot - CVBR,J WP NO.32202_2023 Leggers, Dacoits, Drug - Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders Land - Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") was issued against the petitioner wherein it is alleged that a detention order was passed against him on 02.06.2021 declaring him as "Fake Document offender". It is further case of the petitioner that the respondents herein have not served a copy of the detention order to enable him to question the same. It is further case of the petitioner that he made an application under the Right to Information Act, 2005 to furnish the information relating to detention order No.65/PD-Cell/CYB/2021-23 of the Act and also requested to provide detailed information about the grounds of detention for issuance of the Preventive Detention Order. 3. Sri A.Venkatesh, learned Senior Counsel representing the learned counsel for the petitioner vehemently contended that even CVBR,J WP NO.32202_2023 after making an application vide Chandrakanth Siddarth Kamble vs The State Of Telangana on 22 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109965632/ 1 C.No.A6/94/RTI/Cyb/2023, dated 20.04.2023 requesting to serve copy of the detention order to enable the petitioner to question the same in terms of the Act, the respondents have not furnished the copy of the same, except affixing proclamation notice issued in Proceedings No.65/PD- Cell/CYB/2021-23 dated 24.01.2023. Learned Senior Counsel further contended that the respondents have not followed the procedure as contemplated under the Act before initiating the proceedings against the petitioner under the Act which is violative of Articles 14, 19, 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India.
